desc:
Naruto Inspired PVP game.

Features
Fast-paced PvP arena combat
Multiple playable ninja characters
Skill-based abilities and combos
Ranked battles and leaderboards
Daily challenges and rewards
Regular updates with new characters and abilities

Controls

🖥️ PC
Mouse – Attack
F – Block | E – Sub | R – Up Tilt
Q – Energy/Dash
Z, X, C, V – Special Skills
Shift Lock – Left Alt

🎮 Console
Face Buttons – Attack/Block/Dodge/Jump
L3 – Shift Lock
DpadLeft – Target
DpadRight – Evasive
DpadDown – Up Tilt
L1, L2, R1, R2 – Special Skills

👍 Leave a like and add to your favorites to stay updated!
